attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0): the four-arched stone ground floor, three-light windows under carved lunettes, the lettered frieze, balustrade and pinnacles, dormers, the central gable, the neon roof sign, and the annex with its erker and bell gable.
